text.p: Lehman Brothers said it was maintaining its 1-Buy ranking for Orbotech Ltd after the Israeli company withdrew its public offering of 2.5 million shares due to market conditions.

"Given Orbotech's strong balance sheet ($14 million in cash and virtually no debt), the decision to pull the offering is not expected to have any impact on the company's ability to grow the business," Lehman said in a report.
"We spoke with management and are comfortable that Orbotech is on course for another strong quarter."
Lehman is maintaining its third quarter estimate calling for a 28 percent increase in earnings per share to $0.32, excluding any potential one-time expense related to the aborted equity offering.
